question: The Ukai dam is located on the _____ river.
solution:
The correct answer is__ Tapi.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Ukai Dam** is located across Ukai river which is a tributary of the Tapti /Tapi river in the Tapi district of Gujarat.
 
• The dam was completed in the year **1972**.
 
• The length of the dam is **4962 m **and has a catchment area of **around 62000 Sq.km.**
 
• This dam is also known as **Vallabh Sagar.**
 
• It is meant for Irrigation, Flood control, and Power Generation.
